##### Project general facts

Reportage Hills is the first of Reportage Properties' upscale signature line, a contemporary gated townhouse community tailored to redefine high-end living. This exclusive community offers a collection of three, four, and five-bedroom townhouses with timeless designs and world-class amenities. With sleek architecture that sings in shades of blues, evoking a rhythm of calm elegance and soulful sophistication, Reportage Hills stands out as an icon of timeless beauty.

Residents enjoy an exceptional range of amenities designed to elevate everyday life, including private parking slots for each unit, a large swimming pool, a splash pool, a gym and fitness centre, a kids' play area, shaded seating areas, BBQ stations, landscaped areas, a tennis court, a mosque, and a retail area. Every element is crafted to create a community where real connections thrive and authenticity is the keyword, making everyday life an experience to celebrate.

Every residence at Reportage Hills features customized signature accessories, private balconies or terraces as per unit plan, kitchen cabinets and countertops, fully tiled bathrooms and guest toilets, double-glazed windows, built-in wardrobes in bedrooms, central air conditioning, vanity units and mirrors, and all bedrooms with private bathrooms. Satellite master antenna and fibre optic connection ensure high-speed internet access. The interiors are elegant and warm, inviting sunlight to dance on the shades of blue, where every detail is a statement of class inspired by you.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubailand, designed to be Dubai's entertainment hub, this exceptional location stretches across an immense area in the heart of the city, making it the largest district in Dubai. The area is divided between a vibrant mix of vast residential communities and popular leisure attractions, with well-known residential projects and communities such as Al Barari and Arabian Ranches falling within this district.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to key destinations. Expo City Dubai, Dubai Sports City, Dubai Investments Park, Cityland Mall, Global Village, Plantation Equestrian & Polo Club, Al Maktoum International Airport, Palm Jumeirah, and Burj Khalifa are all within easy reach. According to ServiceMarket, Dubailand has emerged as the most popular neighbourhood in Dubai that residents moved to, making it an unparalleled opportunity for both living and investment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies contemporary elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Dubailand delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class attractions, family-friendly amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can live, grow, and belong — serene, connected and effortlessly refined.
